steps.name: Reclaim unused Android SDK space for Cargo evaluation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
df -h "$RUNNER_TEMP"
unused_android=/usr/local/lib/android
if [[ -d "$unused_android" && ! -L "$unused_android" && "$(realpath -e -- "$unused_android")" == "$unused_android" ]]; then
  sudo rm -rf --one-file-system -- "$unused_android"
fi
df -h "$RUNNER_TEMP"

steps.name: Install pinned recipe prerequisites
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends --yes fish

steps.name: Install the pinned stream fixture compiler
Prepare the fixed native stream component fixture
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -c 'import tomllib; assert tomllib.load(open("tools/toolchain.toml", "rb"))["contracts"]["wasm-tools"] == "1.254.0"'
wasm-tools --version | grep -E '^wasm-tools 1[.]254[.]0([[:space:]]|$)'
wat=crates/latent-wasmtime/src/host/native-stream-outers.wat
test -f "$wat" && test ! -L "$wat"
git cat-file blob "${GITHUB_SHA}:$wat" | cmp - "$wat"
fixture_dir="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-stream-outers.XXXXXXXX")"
wasm-tools parse "$wat" -o "$fixture_dir/native-stream-outers.wasm"
python3 - "$fixture_dir/native-stream-outers.wasm" <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from tools.qualify_stream_outers import FIXTURE_ENV, WAT, fixture_identity

assert WAT == 'crates/latent-wasmtime/src/host/native-stream-outers.wat'
assert FIXTURE_ENV == 'LSF_TEST_STREAM_OUTERS_COMPONENT'
fixture = Path(sys.argv[1])
print('Fixed stream component:', fixture_identity(fixture))
with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
    output.write(f'path={fixture}\n')
PY
